title: Within Reach
endLine: Lipase is born switched on; fat's problem is reach.

scenes.tts: The first film kept the protein cutters switched off until they reached the gut. Lipase, the fat cutter, needs no switch. It is secreted already active. So why is fat the hardest of the three to digest?
scenes.narration: The first film kept the protein cutters switched off until they reached the gut. Lipase, the fat cutter, needs no switch. It is secreted already active. So why is fat the hardest of the three to digest?
scenes.caption: The first film kept the protein cutters switched off until they reached the gut. Lipase, the fat cutter, needs no switch. It is secreted already active. So why is fat the hardest of the three to digest?
scenes.visual: COLOUR MAP carried from the first film (one colour per concept): BLUE = an active enzyme (here lipase; colipase is a small light-BLUE tab on it); GREEN = the substrate that gets cut (here fat); YELLOW = the bond about to be cut (ester bonds); WATER periwinkle = water and the watery gut; GREY = a dormant zymogen with a small 'pro' tab; GOLD = trypsin; RED = a lock or a block (reuse the first film's padlock icon). New in this film: ORANGE = bile salts; PURPLE = lymph and the lacteal; CRIMSON (#9E2B3C, darker than RED) = blood capillary and portal blood. ONE WORLD, kept all film: a 16:9 cross-section of the small intestine. Upper part: the watery lumen, a periwinkle field with slow shimmering ripples and drifting water specks. Lower part (off-frame until s09): the edge of one villus, a row of pale gut cells with a WHITE brush-border edge facing the lumen; inside the villus core a PURPLE lacteal tube, and beside it a CRIMSON blood capillary with small gaps drawn in its wall. A small 'schematic' tag sits bottom right all film. No molecular structures anywhere: fat molecules are block cartoons. OPENING (link-back): for the first sentence, a faint ghost of the first film appears at left: two GREY protease chips with 'pro' tabs and a GOLD trypsin chip flipping them BLUE, tagged 'last time'; it fades out by the end of the sentence. On 'Lipase', the camera is close on the lumen: one large GREEN fat drop fills about 60% of the frame height at centre, with a dozen YELLOW bond marks scattered through its interior. BLUE lipase chips (label 'lipase', no 'pro' tab, already lit) drift in from the edges. On 'secreted already active', each lipase chip pulses BLUE once to show it is on. On the question, large white text at top: 'Why is fat the hard one?'
Title 'Within Reach' fades in at top for 2 s while the question text fades out. The GREEN drop wobbles gently; the BLUE lipase chips keep drifting toward it.

scenes.tts: Look at one drop of fat in the gut. Fat will not dissolve in the watery gut. So lipase reaches only the bonds at the drop's surface. Every bond inside waits.
scenes.narration: Look at one drop of fat in the gut. Fat will not dissolve in the watery gut. So lipase reaches only the bonds at the drop's surface. Every bond inside waits.
scenes.caption: Look at one drop of fat in the gut. Fat will not dissolve in the watery gut. So lipase reaches only the bonds at the drop's surface. Every bond inside waits.
scenes.visual: Same drop, same lumen. On 'will not dissolve', periwinkle water specks bump the drop's edge and slide around it; none enter. The BLUE lipase chips land on the drop's rim and crowd along it; they cannot pass inside. On 'only the bonds at the drop's surface', the few YELLOW bond marks on the rim brighten and the lipase chips beside them snip them (each snipped mark splits and fades). On 'Every bond inside waits', the interior YELLOW marks stay dim and untouched, slowly pulsing; label inside the drop: 'out of reach'. Lipase chips keep jostling along the rim.

scenes.tts: Bile salts break the drop apart, the way soap cuts grease. One drop becomes a cloud of tiny droplets. No bond has been cut yet. This step is pure geometry.
scenes.narration: Bile salts break the drop apart, the way soap cuts grease. One drop becomes a cloud of tiny droplets. No bond has been cut yet. This step is pure geometry.
scenes.caption: Bile salts break the drop apart, the way soap cuts grease. One drop becomes a cloud of tiny droplets. No bond has been cut yet. This step is pure geometry.
scenes.visual: ORANGE bile-salt specks (label 'bile salts') swirl in from the upper left and coat the GREEN drop. On 'break the drop apart', the drop transforms (does not cut to a new picture) by splitting in stages, 1 into 8 into many, into a cloud of small GREEN droplets each with a thin ORANGE coat, spread across the same area. The interior YELLOW marks are carried into the droplets and now sit at their edges. On 'No bond has been cut yet', every YELLOW mark is still whole; a tag reads 'no bonds cut'. On 'geometry', a small outline of the original drop appears as a ghost behind the cloud for comparison. The BLUE lipase chips wait at the side.

scenes.tts: Say bile splits one drop a millimeter across into droplets a micrometer across. The total amount of fat stays the same. How much more surface can lipase now reach?
scenes.narration: Say bile splits one drop a millimeter across into droplets a micrometer across. The total amount of fat stays the same. How much more surface can lipase now reach?
scenes.caption: Say bile splits one drop a millimeter across into droplets a micrometer across. The total amount of fat stays the same. How much more surface can lipase now reach?
scenes.visual: The cloud clears to a clean comparison, still in the lumen: at left one GREEN drop labelled '1 mm across'; an arrow; at right a dense patch of GREEN droplets labelled '1 micrometer each' with a tag 'same total fat' (schematic: droplets are not to scale, since true scale cannot be drawn). The surface of each picture is traced in a bright BLUE outline. Question card at top in white: 'How much more surface?'
Thinking pause. The question card stays. The droplets shimmer slightly, the periwinkle water ripples, and the BLUE outlines glow softly. No other change.

scenes.tts: A thousand times more. The same fat now spreads over a thousand times the surface. And the surface is exactly where lipase works, so far more bonds are within reach.
scenes.narration: A thousand times more. The same fat now spreads over a thousand times the surface. And the surface is exactly where lipase works, so far more bonds are within reach.
scenes.caption: A thousand times more. The same fat now spreads over a thousand times the surface. And the surface is exactly where lipase works, so far more bonds are within reach.
scenes.visual: The question card turns into '1,000 times the surface'. A simple bar pair at right, computed from the lesson's numbers: a short bar 'one drop' of height 1 unit and a bar 'droplets' 1,000 times taller, drawn with a broken axis (marked with a break symbol) so the tall bar fits. On 'where lipase works', the BLUE lipase chips flood in from the side and settle onto the droplet edges all across the patch; YELLOW marks on many droplet edges light up as reachable.

scenes.tts: Now lipase cuts, helped by its partner colipase. It breaks the two outer ester bonds of each triacylglycerol. That leaves one monoacylglycerol and two free fatty acids.
scenes.narration: Now lipase cuts, helped by its partner colipase. It breaks the two outer ester bonds of each triacylglycerol. That leaves one monoacylglycerol and two free fatty acids.
scenes.caption: Now lipase cuts, helped by its partner colipase. It breaks the two outer ester bonds of each triacylglycerol. That leaves one monoacylglycerol and two free fatty acids.
scenes.visual: Camera pushes into one droplet edge until one fat molecule fills about 60% of the frame height. Block cartoon only (no structure): a GREEN spine block labelled 'glycerol' with three GREEN tail blocks attached by YELLOW links; overall label 'triacylglycerol'. A BLUE lipase chip with its light-BLUE 'colipase' tab docks. On 'two outer ester bonds', the top and bottom YELLOW links glow and snap one after the other, each with a small periwinkle water drop spent at the cut (as in the first film's hydrolysis); the middle link stays. The pieces drift apart and relabel: spine with one tail 'monoacylglycerol', two loose tails 'fatty acid' and 'fatty acid'.

scenes.tts: Here is the one idea. Lipase never needed switching on. Its problem is reach: an active enzyme cuts only the bonds it can touch. So the gut's work on fat is exposure.
scenes.narration: Here is the one idea. Lipase never needed switching on. Its problem is reach: an active enzyme cuts only the bonds it can touch. So the gut's work on fat is exposure.
scenes.caption: Here is the one idea. Lipase never needed switching on. Its problem is reach: an active enzyme cuts only the bonds it can touch. So the gut's work on fat is exposure.
scenes.visual: Pull back to the droplet cloud in the lumen; cut pieces drift among the droplets. On 'never needed switching on', a GREY 'pro' tab ghost appears beside a BLUE lipase chip, gets a RED cross and fades. On 'only the bonds it can touch', two droplets glow side by side: one large drop with dim interior YELLOW marks, one small droplet whose YELLOW edge marks are being snipped. Large white text across the top: 'active enzyme + exposed bond'. On 'exposure', the ORANGE bile coats on all droplets pulse once.

scenes.tts: Reach matters again on the way in. Bile salts gather the pieces into micelles, tiny bundles. The micelles ferry them through the watery layer to the gut cell.
scenes.narration: Reach matters again on the way in. Bile salts gather the pieces into micelles, tiny bundles. The micelles ferry them through the watery layer to the gut cell.
scenes.caption: Reach matters again on the way in. Bile salts gather the pieces into micelles, tiny bundles. The micelles ferry them through the watery layer to the gut cell.
scenes.visual: Camera pans down the same world: the droplet cloud moves to the top edge and the villus edge rises into view, gut cells with their WHITE brush-border edge filling the lower 45%. The loose GREEN pieces (monoacylglycerol and fatty acid tails) are gathered by ORANGE bile-salt specks into small round ORANGE-rimmed bundles labelled 'micelles'. On 'ferry', the micelles cross the periwinkle water to the WHITE brush border and release their GREEN pieces, which pass into one gut cell (label 'gut cell'). The empty ORANGE rims drift back up into the lumen. Keep the droplet cloud, micelles, gut cells, and the dim lacteal and capillary below as the only things on screen.

scenes.tts: Inside the cell, the pieces are rebuilt into fat. Why undo digestion? Rebuilding uses the pieces up as they arrive, so more keep flowing in. It also stops free fatty acids acting as detergents.
scenes.narration: Inside the cell, the pieces are rebuilt into fat. Why undo digestion? Rebuilding uses the pieces up as they arrive, so more keep flowing in. It also stops free fatty acids acting as detergents.
scenes.caption: Inside the cell, the pieces are rebuilt into fat. Why undo digestion? Rebuilding uses the pieces up as they arrive, so more keep flowing in. It also stops free fatty acids acting as detergents.
scenes.visual: Camera centres on the one gut cell, filling about 65% of the frame height. Inside it, GREEN tails reattach to GREEN spines with new YELLOW links, forming whole triacylglycerol blocks again (block cartoon). Label 'rebuilt'. On 'Why undo digestion?', white text 'why undo it?' appears briefly. On 'uses the pieces up as they arrive', a small level gauge inside the cell labelled 'free pieces inside' stays low (schematic) while a steady stream of GREEN pieces keeps entering at the brush border. On 'detergents', a ghost of a loose fatty-acid tail nudging the cell's membrane appears, then the tail is snapped into a rebuilt block and the ghost fades.

scenes.tts: The rebuilt fat is wrapped in protein and shipped out as chylomicrons. Each one is far larger than the openings in a blood capillary's wall.
scenes.narration: The rebuilt fat is wrapped in protein and shipped out as chylomicrons. Each one is far larger than the openings in a blood capillary's wall.
scenes.caption: The rebuilt fat is wrapped in protein and shipped out as chylomicrons. Each one is far larger than the openings in a blood capillary's wall.
scenes.visual: The rebuilt GREEN blocks gather into a big round particle wrapped in a thin WHITE protein shell, labelled 'chylomicron'. It moves to the bottom of the gut cell and out into the villus core. Camera eases to show the CRIMSON blood capillary with small gaps in its wall (label 'blood capillary') beside the PURPLE lacteal. On 'far larger than the openings', the chylomicron drifts to the capillary wall: it is many times wider than the gaps, nudges, and bounces back; the first film's RED padlock icon flashes on the capillary wall. Schematic sizes.

scenes.tts: But at the center of each villus runs a lymph vessel, the lacteal, with loose junctions. Chylomicrons slip through and take the scenic route, through the lymph. Cholesterol and fat-soluble vitamins ride along.
scenes.narration: But at the center of each villus runs a lymph vessel, the lacteal, with loose junctions. Chylomicrons slip through and take the scenic route, through the lymph. Cholesterol and fat-soluble vitamins ride along.
scenes.caption: But at the center of each villus runs a lymph vessel, the lacteal, with loose junctions. Chylomicrons slip through and take the scenic route, through the lymph. Cholesterol and fat-soluble vitamins ride along.
scenes.visual: The PURPLE lacteal brightens, labelled 'lacteal (lymph)'. Its wall is drawn as overlapping flaps with wide loose gaps. On 'slip through', the chylomicron squeezes between two flaps and enters; more chylomicrons follow from the gut cell. On 'scenic route', the chylomicrons flow down the PURPLE tube and out of frame along a long curving PURPLE path, labelled 'lymph'. On 'Cholesterol and fat-soluble vitamins', a few small GREEN specks inside the chylomicrons twinkle, tag 'along for the ride'.

scenes.tts: The other pieces need no detour. Sugars, amino acids, and short- and medium-chain fatty acids are water-soluble enough. They leave for the portal blood and the liver.
scenes.narration: The other pieces need no detour. Sugars, amino acids, and short- and medium-chain fatty acids are water-soluble enough. They leave for the portal blood and the liver.
scenes.caption: The other pieces need no detour. Sugars, amino acids, and short- and medium-chain fatty acids are water-soluble enough. They leave for the portal blood and the liver.
scenes.visual: Same villus. Small WHITE dots labelled 'sugars, amino acids' and a few short GREEN stubs labelled 'short, medium chains' leave the bottom of the gut cell and pass straight through the gaps in the CRIMSON capillary wall, flowing away along a CRIMSON path labelled 'portal blood' toward a simple liver outline at the right edge labelled 'liver'. At the same time the chylomicrons keep flowing down the PURPLE lymph path on the other side. Two routes, two colours, side by side.

scenes.tts: So, start to finish, the fat lane turns on access, not activation. Make surface for the cutter, ferry the pieces across, then find a door wide enough to leave.
scenes.narration: So, start to finish, the fat lane turns on access, not activation. Make surface for the cutter, ferry the pieces across, then find a door wide enough to leave.
scenes.caption: So, start to finish, the fat lane turns on access, not activation. Make surface for the cutter, ferry the pieces across, then find a door wide enough to leave.
scenes.visual: Pull back to the whole world: droplet cloud in the lumen above, gut cells, lacteal and capillary below. On 'access, not activation', the BLUE lipase chips pulse (already on) and a white tag reads 'access, not activation'. Then three steps light in turn along the fat's path: on 'Make surface', the droplet cloud with its ORANGE coats; on 'ferry the pieces', the micelles crossing the water; on 'a door wide enough', the loose gaps of the PURPLE lacteal with a chylomicron slipping through. Sugar dots keep flowing into the CRIMSON capillary.

End card over the dimmed but still moving world (droplets shimmering, micelles drifting, chylomicrons flowing down the PURPLE lymph path). Large centred white text: 'Lipase is born switched on; fat's problem is reach.' The word 'reach' in BLUE.
